claim.polarity: every effect on a required surface in the scope took a mediated route

integrity_inputs.provenance: synthetic stage-1 declaration for design review; no signature or chain verification was performed
integrity_inputs.visible_log: consistent: seq 0-2 contiguous, no repeated record_id

assumptions.text: db-audit-feed is produced by the database independently of the agent gateway and emits one entry, with its own feed_seq, for every committed write
within an available segment, a feed_seq range from first_seq to last_seq with heartbeats and no declared gaps means no committed write in that segment went unreported

the route field of db-audit-feed is authoritative; credential svc-rp-db is held only by relying party rp-db, and rp-db uses it only to execute writes after verifying a capability bound to exactly one gateway record. This mediation policy is assumed; holding the credential alone would not show it
rp-http-ledger records every request executed at the gw-http endpoint, one numbered entry per execution
the route field of rp-http-ledger is authoritative; route rp-http-capability is recorded only for requests executed after verifying a capability bound to exactly one gateway record
each effect_ref identifies exactly one execution and is never reused, and the route evidence and mediation policies apply throughout the claim interval

observations.mechanism: relying-party execution ledger, one numbered entry per executed request, with the execution route
database audit feed: one entry per committed write with its execution route, 60-second heartbeats, sequenced feed_seq

segments.reason: feed unreadable: no entries or heartbeats retrievable

mediation_evidence.statement: an effect on gw-http whose route is rp-http-capability was executed only after a capability bound to exactly one gateway record was verified
an effect on alt-db whose route is svc-rp-db was executed by rp-db only after a capability bound to exactly one gateway record was verified
